title: Prince Louis holiday photo released to mark eighth birthday
originalTitle: Prince Louis holiday photo released to mark eighth birthday
content:
The Prince and Princess of Wales have released a new photograph to mark Prince Louis' eighth birthday - showing their youngest son on a family holiday to Cornwall.

The prince - smiling and wearing a blue zip-up jumper - has his arms folded and onboard a boat, with the sea behind him.

The image was shared on royal social media accounts by Prince William and Catherine who wrote: "Happy birthday, Louis! 8 today!" followed by a red balloon emoji.

The photo was taken by photographer Matt Porteous earlier this month.

Porteous has received royal commissions in the past from Prince William and Catherine, including for behind the scenes moments from Louis' christening.

Prince Louis Arthur Charles - known as His Royal Highness Prince Louis of Wales - was born at St Mary's Hospital in Paddington on 23 April 2018.

He is third child of the Prince and Princess of Wales after Prince George, 12, and Princess Charlotte, 10 and is fourth in the line of succession to the throne.

Known for his cheeky antics, the prince rarely accompanies his parents on royal engagements, but is often seen at significant events including the annual Trooping the Colour Parade and Easter Sunday.
